text: As I wander these bright, sterile halls and modern displays, I feel a curious detachment from the utilitarian function of this space—a juxtaposition of intellectual inquiry and ordered design. The clean glass walls and the R+D exhibit's abstract graphics provoke in me a sense of anticipation, as if on the edge between discovery and routine. The world here is focused and analytical, yet my mind drifts, pondering what true innovation feels like at the human level, and whether it can be insulated from the mundanity of institutional life.
